description: Regression thresholds for the versioned deterministic test corpus. These thresholds are software-quality gates, not real-world efficacy claims.

adversarial_telemetry.description: Every case the corpus marks detectable must be detected. Deliberately not a rate over the whole corpus: the corpus contains cases that pattern matching cannot catch, and a whole-corpus rate would fall whenever an honest undetectable case is added, which would punish making the corpus more truthful.
